description: This PHP source file defines a single function `install_social()` which is responsible for installing social-related hooks in the SuiteCRM system. It includes a requirement for a module installer and sets up a hook to load social JavaScript after the UI frame. The file contains licensing information and setup code relevant to the SuiteCRM and SugarCRM projects.

methods.name: install_social
methods.description: Initializes the social module installation by requiring the module installer and setting up a logic hook for loading social JavaScript.
